rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent stepped bar in all four views, so gesture and repair integrity are strong. The dominant issue is programmatic: the mass behaves like a generic terraced object with almost no visible public void, court, or undercut responding to the access edge. The blue frontage is not clearly converted into an active threshold; the ground condition is sealed rather than porous. That said, the silhouette is not arbitrary and the section has some capacity-bearing stepped logic, so the form remains plausible for neighborhood living, just underdeveloped at the ground/public interface. It does not violate the parcel containment or multi-view coherence gates, and there is no obvious view-dependent collision.
